Messages.Author: Gabriel
Messages.Body:
Would someone please give me some help with these questions?

Bonding -
With superior dominate, can you use the +1 stealth for an action other
than bleeding since the card reads "+1 bleed and +1 stealth"?

additional strikes -
Do additional strike cards need to be played at the beginning of a
round? Or can they "surprise" you with an additional strike after the
strike resolution?

Trap -
Would someone give me their opinion on how this card should work? Can
you play a Torn Signpost and then Trap on the first turn? And does trap
mean the other player can't play cards or that three rounds of combat
continue AFTER he doesn't play any more cards? Also, is the press from Trap
optional each round? AND, can you use the press from equipment (e.g. hawg)
to cancel the press from Trap?

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In article <73hk2k$l...@news.millennianet.com>, Gabriel <j...@rfd.com>
writes

>Would someone please give me some help with these questions?
>
>Bonding -
> With superior dominate, can you use the +1 stealth for an action other
>than bleeding since the card reads "+1 bleed and +1 stealth"?
>

No. You can't use a modifier on something that doesn't have it to
modify. A non-bleed action has no bleed to modify, so you can't play
it.

>additional strikes -
> Do additional strike cards need to be played at the beginning of a
>round?

No. In fact, they cannot be played then.

>Or can they "surprise" you with an additional strike after the
>strike resolution?
>

That's who it work.

>Trap -
> Would someone give me their opinion on how this card should work? Can
>you play a Torn Signpost and then Trap on the first turn?

Erm, I think so. Yes.

> And does trap
>mean the other player can't play cards

Not at all. why would it mean that?

>or that three rounds of combat
>continue AFTER he doesn't play any more cards?

No, after no cards are played, by either of you.

>Also, is the press from Trap
>optional each round?

Not as far as I know, no.

>AND, can you use the press from equipment (e.g. hawg)
>to cancel the press from Trap?
>

Erm... LSJ? But I think yes.

>

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Dhar...@yahoo.com wrote:
> > You can use a press from any source to cancel the press from Trap, yes.
>
> This is assuming that you are not the player who played the Trap.

The press to end can come from either minion, since the press (to continue)
supplied by the trap is not considered to have come from either of them.
Similarly for the press from a Frenzy. [TOM 22-SEP-95]

Compare: "combat has a press" (Trap) to "You get one press" (Conquer the
Beast).

In the former, the combat itself has a press, in the latter, the combatant
has a press.

> Last I checked, you cannot cancel your own presses.

That is correct.
